items.name: APB-I2S
items.description: I2S (Inter-IC Sound) interface module with APB (Advanced Peripheral Bus) interface signals. It has control logic for writing and reading data to/from a 4x32-bit FIFO and generates clock (sck), word select (ws), and serial data (sd) signals for I2S transmission.

items.name: Audio-Jacked
items.description: an audio filter system with a touchscreen interface. Processor designed and built in Verilog. VHDL modules to control the audio input (microphone) and output (i2s protocol to an audio jack) as well as the touchscreen (the touchscreen interface was modified from the sample project provided by Digilent). Data stored in PSRAM
